name: Auth0 Development
goal: Pass the Auth0 Certified Developer exam (Okta certification). The exam has two parts: Part I is DOMC (Discrete Option Multiple Choice) covering planning, authentication, user management, customization, security, monitoring, and the Management API. Part II is hands-on practical tasks (~50% of score) performed in a live Auth0 tenant — SSO setup, passwordless, custom DB connections, social connections, bulk migration, Organizations + RBAC, token enrichment via Actions, Universal Login branding, custom Actions, and MFA.

Shift from depth-drilling to breadth: sweep the untaught practical layer (flows, connections, sessions/logout, Actions, Organizations, MFA, migration, branding, Management API) to widen exam coverage. Unlock a concept's dependents once its prerequisites reach mastery >= prereq_threshold (0.4, ~two passes) instead of the default 0.7 (~four passes). This overrides the default 0.7 prerequisite gate in CLAUDE.md for THIS domain. Prefer introducing a NEW unlocked concept over re-drilling an already-passing one, unless it is overdue or struggling (mastery < 0.4 with reps > 0).
